source: Public race results: Jibeset (www.jibeset.net, GGYC Seaweed Soup) and Regatta Network (www.regattanetwork.com, Sausalito YC Classic Boat Invitational, SFYC Resin Regatta). Fetched by scripts/fetch-folkboat-results.mjs.
notes: Times are local (Pacific). elapsedS is from the fleet's start to the boat's finish, in seconds.
Jibeset races: finish and elapsed times for every finisher, the start time, course number and nominal distance (nm).

Regatta Network races: places and the start time only; finish times appear for one or two boats in a few races and are hand-entered, so they are kept but not used for speed. A start of 00:00:00 there means not entered (null here).
place is the finishing place among finishers (null for a scoring code). points are as published.
key is the digits of the sail number, to follow one boat across events (sail numbers are typed differently by each scorer).

Course numbers are on GGYC's course sheet (Addendum B), which is the same table in 2025–26 and 2026–27 (Jibeset DOC=cr for 2025–26, DOC=X0 for 2026–27), so src/courses/data serves both seasons. Where the scorer's distance disagrees with the sheet's for the course number (2025–26 races 1 and 4: course 3 given as 6.1 nm, the sheet 3.7; course 13 as 8.9, the sheet 5.0), one of the two was typed wrong: sim/realRaces.ts says so beside the race.
Distances are the scorer's nominal course lengths, not sailed distances.
Regatta Network gives every 2023 SYC Classic race the date 2023-06-11 although the event ran June–October; treat those dates as unsure.
Skippers are as published, tidied to one spelling; a boat can have several skippers over the years.

spread.note: Elapsed times % behind the race winner. Seaweed Soup races (GGYC), 5–8 Folkboats, courses of 3–7 nm.

consistency.note: Kendall's tau between two races' finishing orders over the boats that finished both: 1 = same order, 0 = no relation. Relative place: 0 = won, 1 = last finisher. Boats and skippers with 4+ finishes.

wind.note: Fort Point (NOAA 9414290) mean wind over the race (start to the winner's finish where timed, else the first hour). Fort Point reads the Gate; the race areas are usually a little lighter. orderByWind: Kendall's tau between each race's order and the fleet's usual order (all races with observed wind). races: the timed races, last finisher's gap against wind; winner speed is over the nominal course distance and includes the current, so it is not boat speed.

gaps.note: Mean % behind each race's winner, over the timed races each boat finished (3+). The top boat's own figure is above 0 because it doesn't win every race.

topByPlace.note: The fleet's top boat by place over all races (Regatta Network included); it sailed none of the timed races.
